label: run-03
method: Identical to run-01 and run-02. One agent per shard of 25 questions, 19 shards this time because batch 15 took the suite from 441 to 457 questions. Dispatched from runs/prompt.md verbatim with only the shard path and output path substituted. Each agent was given the question ids and text only, plus the path to R9_1_GX_CLI_Reference/, and was forbidden to read anything under tools/ so the expected facts and reference answers could not leak.
corpus_note: Same commit as the tests. This is the first run to cover chapters 3 to 5, which batch 15 added; runs 01 and 02 have no answers for those 16 questions and compare_runs.py reports them as unanswered rather than failed.
score_note: Scored against the tests at the commit the answers were produced at. Compare with the other runs only via compare_runs.py, which rescores every stored run against the working tree.
dispatch_note: Two dispatch faults, neither affecting the answers. Shards 17-19 were initially rejected by the 20-agent concurrency cap and were dispatched once slots freed. The first shard-01 agent delegated to five sub-agents of its own and returned without writing any file; it was re-dispatched with the identical prompt and completed normally. Its sub-agents' output was discarded and never entered the run, so the one-agent-per-shard method is intact.
